name: Lebelage Vita Ampoule
description: A concentrated brightening ampoule for tired, dull skin.
details: Key ingredients: Niacinamide, Vitamin C derivative, Centella Asiatica. Apply 2-3 drops after toner, morning and night. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Collagen Firming Ampoule
description: A firming ampoule that targets fine lines and loss of elasticity.
details: Key ingredients: Marine Collagen, Adenosine, Peptide Complex. Apply after cleansing before moisturizer. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Aqua Ceramide Cream
description: A lightweight moisture cream that locks in hydration under humidity.
details: Key ingredients: Ceramide NP, Hyaluronic Acid, Squalane. Use as the last step of your morning and evening routine. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Snail Repair Cream
description: A repairing night cream for stressed, sun-exposed skin.
details: Key ingredients: Snail Secretion Filtrate 92%, Panthenol. Best used at night as the final step. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Rice Bright Foam Cleanser
description: A gentle brightening foam cleanser for daily use.
details: Key ingredients: Rice Extract, Amino Acid Surfactants. Massage onto damp skin, rinse with lukewarm water. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Tea Tree Purifying Foam
description: A purifying cleanser for oily, congestion-prone skin.
details: Key ingredients: Tea Tree Leaf Oil, Salicylic Acid (BHA). Use morning and night on damp skin. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Sun Shield SPF50+
description: A lightweight, no-white-cast SPF built for island days.
details: SPF50+ PA++++. Broad spectrum. Reapply every 2-3 hours in direct sun. Water-resistant. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Aqua Sun Stick SPF50+
description: A portable, mess-free sun stick for on-the-go reapplication.
details: SPF50+ PA++++. Twist-up stick format, easy to reapply over makeup. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Calming Green Toner
description: A soothing first-step toner for sensitive, heat-flushed skin.
details: Key ingredients: Centella Asiatica, Green Tea Extract, Panthenol. Pat onto cleansed skin with hands or cotton pad. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Vita Brightening Toner
description: A brightening toner that preps skin for the rest of your routine.
details: Key ingredients: Vitamin C derivative, Niacinamide. Apply after cleansing, before serum. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Aqua Reset Mask
description: A calming overnight mask that restores moisture after long days by the sea.
details: Key ingredients: Hyaluronic Acid, Aloe Vera, Panthenol. Sheet mask, 15-20 minutes, or leave on overnight (wash-off type). Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Rice Sheet Mask (5-Pack)
description: A brightening rice sheet mask set for a weekly glow ritual.
details: Key ingredients: Rice Extract, Rice Bran Water. 5 individually packed sheet masks. 15-20 minutes per use. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Foam Pack 2in1 Cleanser & Mask
description: A dual-purpose foam that works as a wash-off mask or everyday cleanser.
details: Key ingredients: Kaolin Clay, Charcoal. Leave on 5-10 minutes as a mask, or rinse immediately as a cleanser. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Milk Foam Pack 2in1
description: A gentle milk-based 2-in-1 foam pack for soft, calm skin.
details: Key ingredients: Milk Protein, Shea Butter. Use daily as a cleanser or twice weekly as a mask. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Centella Toner Pad (70pcs)
description: Pre-soaked calming pads for quick, gentle exfoliation and toning.
details: Key ingredients: Centella Asiatica, PHA. 70 pads per jar. Sweep across cleansed skin, avoiding eye area. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Vita Glow Toner Pad (70pcs)
description: Brightening toner pads for a quick radiance boost.
details: Key ingredients: Vitamin C derivative, Adenosine. Use morning and night after cleansing. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Aqua Body Lotion
description: A fast-absorbing body lotion for all-day hydration in humid climates.
details: Key ingredients: Hyaluronic Acid, Shea Butter, Aloe Vera. Apply after showering. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Milk Skin Lotion
description: A classic lightweight facial lotion for the second step of your routine.
details: Key ingredients: Milk Protein, Niacinamide. Apply after toner, before cream. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Velvet Matte Lip Tint
description: A weightless matte tint that lasts through island humidity.
details: Long-wearing, transfer-resistant formula. Available in a range of coral and rose shades. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Skin Fit Cushion Foundation
description: A lightweight cushion foundation with buildable, natural coverage.
details: SPF50+ PA+++. Includes refill-compatible compact and puff. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Peptide Eye Cream
description: A firming eye cream that targets fine lines and puffiness.

name: Lebelage Snail Eye Gel Cream
description: A cooling gel-cream hybrid for tired, dehydrated under-eyes.
details: Key ingredients: Snail Secretion Filtrate, Hyaluronic Acid. Lightweight gel texture, ideal for humid climates. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Aloe Soothing Gel
description: A classic aloe gel for daily cooling hydration after sun exposure.

name: Lebelage Aqua Ceramide Emulsion
description: A lightweight lotion-cream hybrid that layers well under Maldives humidity.
details: Key ingredients: Ceramide NP, Hyaluronic Acid. Apply after toner, before cream. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Snail Repair Emulsion
description: A repairing emulsion for dull, tired skin in need of a reset.
details: Key ingredients: Snail Secretion Filtrate, Panthenol. Apply after toner or essence. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Vita Serum
description: A Lebelage debut essence selected for Maldives skin — brightening, hydrating, and weightless under tropical humidity.
details: Key ingredients: Vitamin C derivative, Niacinamide, Adenosine. Apply after toner, before moisturizer. Made in South Korea.

name: Lebelage Galactomyces Essence

name: Lebelage Lip Sleeping Balm
description: An overnight lip treatment for soft, hydrated lips by morning.

name: Lebelage Travel Pouch Gift Set
description: A curated travel-size set of Atoreum MV bestsellers in a reusable pouch.
details: Includes travel sizes of toner, essence, and cream. Perfect for gifting or island-hopping. Made in South Korea.
